title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十五章、失踪的侍卫

    在侍卫营的库房里，包拯和公孙策找到了火灾发生时的宫门出入记录本，但发现那几天的记录被人撕掉了。他们正失望的时候，包拯的眼睛忽然又亮了。他看到了堆放在门边的几个箱子，箱子上面写着“侍卫值班记录”。
    侍卫值班记录是负责宫门守卫的侍卫营的工作记录，值守侍卫的名字、值守时间以及守在宫门的哪个位置，每天都会有记录。现在宫门出入记录虽然被撕掉了，但说不定侍卫值班记录还有希望，里面也许会有线索。
    包拯跳起来去那几个箱子里翻找，公孙策马上也明白了，跟着包拯一起翻找起来。很快，他们找到了。侍卫值班记录很完整，火灾发生前后的那几天，十一月五日、六日、七日、八日，每一天的记录都在，值班侍卫的名字和值班时间都记录得非常详细。
    包拯一页页地翻看着，他在观察，也在思考。
    “怎么样？有发现吗？”公孙策着急地问。
    包拯没有回答，他把那一年的记录全部看完了，然后又翻回到了七日那一页，指着一个名字说：“你看，‘高小山’这个名字，七日后就再也没有出现过了。”
    公孙策把本子拿过去仔细看了一遍，然后惊叹道：“七日前有这个名字，七日也有，七日后就没有了。七日，就是冷宫火灾发生的那一天！”
    “走，找卫宁去！”包拯站起身来说。
    侍卫营里几十个侍卫正在休息，卫宁不在这儿。
    “请问，卫总管去哪儿了？”包拯拦住一个三十多岁的侍卫问。
    “不知道。”侍卫摇头要走。
    “等一等！”包拯拉住他问：“你认识高小山吗？”
    “谁？”侍卫一脸疑惑。
    “高小山，他以前也是侍卫营的！”
    “没听说过。”侍卫回头对着里面正在休息的那几十个侍卫喊道：“你们有谁认识高小山？”
    没有人回答，一片安静。看来二十多年前的人，真的没有人知道了。包拯失望地向侍卫道声谢，然后和公孙策一起离开了。
    刚走出侍卫营没多远，一个很老的声音在身后响起。
    “你们……为什么找高小山？”
    包拯回头，一个年老的侍卫正慢慢从后面走来。
    “你认识高小山？”包拯惊喜问道。
    老侍卫看了看他，又看了看公孙策，犹豫地问：“你是开封府的包大人吗？”
    “是我，我是包拯！”
    老侍卫松了一口气，脸色变温和了。他说：“高小山二十多年前就死了，您找他做什么？”
fullText.traditional:
第十五章、失蹤的侍衛

    在侍衛營的庫房裡，包拯和公孫策找到了火災發生時的宮門出入記錄本，但發現那幾天的記錄被人撕掉了。他們正失望的時候，包拯的眼睛忽然又亮了。他看到了堆放在門邊的幾個箱子，箱子上面寫著“侍衛值班記錄”。
    侍衛值班記錄是負責宮門守衛的侍衛營的工作記錄，值守侍衛的名字、值守時間以及守在宮門的哪個位置，每天都會有記錄。現在宮門出入記錄雖然被撕掉了，但說不定侍衛值班記錄還有希望，裡面也許會有線索。
    包拯跳起來去那幾個箱子裡翻找，公孫策馬上也明白了，跟著包拯一起翻找起來。很快，他們找到了。侍衛值班記錄很完整，火災發生前後的那幾天，十一月五日、六日、七日、八日，每一天的記錄都在，值班侍衛的名字和值班時間都記錄得非常詳細。
    包拯一頁頁地翻看著，他在觀察，也在思考。
    “怎麼樣？有發現嗎？”公孫策著急地問。
    包拯沒有回答，他把那一年的記錄全部看完了，然後又翻回到了七日那一頁，指著一個名字說：“你看，‘高小山’這個名字，七日後就再也沒有出現過了。”
    公孫策把本子拿過去仔細看了一遍，然後驚嘆道：“七日前有這個名字，七日也有，七日後就沒有了。七日，就是冷宮火災發生的那一天！”
    “走，找衛寧去！”包拯站起身來說。
    侍衛營裡幾十個侍衛正在休息，衛寧不在這兒。
    “請問，衛總管去哪兒了？”包拯攔住一個三十多歲的侍衛問。
    “不知道。”侍衛搖頭要走。
    “等一等！”包拯拉住他問：“你認識高小山嗎？”
    “誰？”侍衛一臉疑惑。
    “高小山，他以前也是侍衛營的！”
    “沒聽說過。”侍衛回頭對著裡面正在休息的那幾十個侍衛喊道：“你們有誰認識高小山？”
    沒有人回答，一片安靜。看來二十多年前的人，真的沒有人知道了。包拯失望地向侍衛道聲謝，然後和公孫策一起離開了。
    剛走出侍衛營沒多遠，一個很老的聲音在身後響起。
    “你們……為什麼找高小山？”
    包拯回頭，一個年老的侍衛正慢慢從後面走來。
    “你認識高小山？”包拯驚喜問道。
    老侍衛看了看他，又看了看公孫策，猶豫地問：“你是開封府的包大人嗎？”
    “是我，我是包拯！”
    老侍衛鬆了一口氣，臉色變溫和了。他說：“高小山二十多年前就死了，您找他做什麼？”

sentences.traditional: 包拯回頭，一個年老的侍衛正慢慢從後面走來。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng huí tóu yí ge nián lǎo de shì wèi zhèng màn man cóng hòu miàn zǒu lái
sentences.english: Bao Zheng turned around. An elderly guard was slowly approaching from behind.

sentences.simplified: “你认识高小山？”包拯惊喜问道。
sentences.traditional: “你認識高小山？”包拯驚喜問道。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ rèn shi gāo xiǎo shān bāo zhěng jīng xǐ wèn dào
sentences.english: “Do you know Gao Xiaoshan?” Bao Zheng asked in surprise.

sentences.simplified: 老侍卫看了看他，又看了看公孙策，犹豫地问：“你是开封府的包大人吗？”
sentences.traditional: 老侍衛看了看他，又看了看公孫策，猶豫地問：“你是開封府的包大人嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo shì wèi kàn le kàn tā yòu kàn le kàn gōng sūn cè yóu yù de wèn nǐ shì kāi fēng fǔ de bāo dà ren ma
sentences.english: The old guard looked at him, then at Gongsun Ce, and hesitantly asked, “Are you Lord Bao from Kaifeng Mansion?”

sentences.simplified: “是我，我是包拯！”
sentences.traditional: “是我，我是包拯！”
sentences.pinyin: shì wǒ wǒ shì bāo zhěng
sentences.english: “It’s me, I am Bao Zheng!”

sentences.simplified: 老侍卫松了一口气，脸色变温和了。
sentences.traditional: 老侍衛鬆了一口氣，臉色變溫和了。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo shì wèi sōng le yì kǒu qì liǎn sè biàn wēn hé le
sentences.english: The old guard let out a sigh of relief, and his face softened.

sentences.simplified: 他说：“高小山二十多年前就死了，您找他做什么？”
sentences.traditional: 他說：“高小山二十多年前就死了，您找他做什麼？”
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō gāo xiǎo shān èr shí duō nián qián jiù sǐ le nín zhǎo tā zuò shén me
sentences.english: He said, “Gao Xiaoshan died more than twenty years ago. Why are you looking for him?”

sentence_translations: Chapter 15: The Missing Guard
In the storeroom of the imperial guard camp, ..
.. Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce found the Palace Gate Entry and Exit Record Book from the time the fire happened.
But they discovered that the records for those few days had been torn out.
Just when they were feeling disappointed, Bao Zheng’s eyes suddenly lit up again.
He saw several boxes piled up by the door, with “Guard Duty Log” written on them.
The Guard Duty Log was the work record of the imperial guard camp responsible for guarding the palace gates.
The names of the guards on duty, their duty times, and their positions at the palace gate were recorded every day.
Although the palace entry and exit records had been torn out, ..
.. there could still be hope for the Guard Duty Log, which might contain some clues.
Bao Zheng jumped up to rummage through those boxes, and Gongsun Ce immediately understood, joining Bao Zheng in the search.
Soon, they found it.
The Guard Duty Log was very complete, covering the days before and after the fire: November 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th.
The records for each day were all there, with the names of the guards on duty and their duty times recorded in great detail.
Bao Zheng flipped through the pages one by one, observing and thinking.
“What do you think? Can you find anything?” Gongsun Ce asked anxiously.
Bao Zheng did not answer.
He read through all of the records of that year, then turned back to the page of the 7th, pointing to a name, and said, ..
.. “Look, the name ‘Gao Xiaoshan’ never appeared again after the 7th.”
Gongsun Ce took the book and carefully looked it over, then exclaimed, ..
.. “This name was there before the 7th, and also there on the 7th. But after the 7th, it’s gone.
The 7th, that’s the day when the fire happened in the Cold Palace!”
“Let’s go find Wei Ning!” Bao Zheng stood up and said.
Dozens of guards were resting in the imperial guard camp. Wei Ning was not here.
“Excuse me, where did the chief imperial bodyguard Wei go?” Bao Zheng stopped a guard in his thirties to ask.
“I don’t know.” The guard shook his head and was about to leave.
“Wait a moment!” Bao Zheng grabbed him and asked, “Do you know Gao Xiaoshan?”
“Who?” The guard looked puzzled.
“Gao Xiaoshan, he used to be in the imperial guard camp too!”
“Never heard of him.” The guard turned around and shouted to the dozens of guards resting inside, ..
.. “Does anyone know Gao Xiaoshan?”
No one answered. It was completely quiet.
It seemed that no one really knew about a person from more than twenty years ago.
Bao Zheng, disappointed, thanked the guard and then left with Gongsun Ce.
Just after walking out of the imperial guard camp, an old voice sounded from behind.
“Why are you looking for Gao Xiaoshan?”
Bao Zheng turned around. An elderly guard was slowly approaching from behind.
“Do you know Gao Xiaoshan?” Bao Zheng asked in surprise.
The old guard looked at him, then at Gongsun Ce, and hesitantly asked, “Are you Lord Bao from Kaifeng Mansion?”
“It’s me, I am Bao Zheng!”
The old guard let out a sigh of relief, and his face softened.
He said, “Gao Xiaoshan died more than twenty years ago. Why are you looking for him?”
